# Séance 0.3.33
Claude chats on the Mac open on the phone and iPad again. A chat could stay on "Preparing conversation…" on another device and never show its messages. That happened most often once Claude was idle, and in projects reached through a shortcut to another drive. The Mac had found the chat's conversation but then turned it down, because it compared the chat's folder in two different forms. It now reads them the same way, and chats already open recover once this update is installed.
The sidebar no longer shows a network message while a computer reconnects; the computer's heading already says so. A message appears only when the connection needs you, for example to sign in again, and only once that has lasted 15 seconds.
Projects with no chats look like the rest of the list when you open them. Once that fold is open it reads, for example, "No chats in 11 projects".
